description: This file contains classes and functions related to DOM element handling, execution context, and interaction utilities within the Playwright testing framework. It defines classes like FrameExecutionContext and ElementHandle, along with utility functions for error handling and coordinate calculations.

classes.name: FrameExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents an execution context within a frame, capable of evaluating scripts and managing injected scripts.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a DOM element, providing methods for interaction, evaluation, and state checks.

classes.name: NonRecoverableDOMError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating a non-recoverable DOM error.

methods.name: isNonRecoverableDOMError
methods.description: Checks if an error is an instance of NonRecoverableDOMError.

methods.name: throwRetargetableDOMError
methods.description: Throws an error if the result indicates a disconnected element, otherwise returns the result.

methods.name: throwElementIsNotAttached
methods.description: Throws an error indicating the DOM element is not attached.

methods.name: assertDone
methods.description: Ensures the result is 'done' and converts it to void.

methods.name: roundPoint
methods.description: Rounds a point to two decimal places.

methods.name: quadMiddlePoint
methods.description: Calculates the middle point of a quadrilateral.

methods.name: triangleArea
methods.description: Calculates the area of a triangle given three points.

methods.name: isPointInsideQuad
methods.description: Checks if a point is inside a quadrilateral.

methods.name: findIntegerPointInsideQuad
methods.description: Finds an integer coordinate point inside a quadrilateral.
